predeclared_outcomes: candidate is a source review lead only. For typed-endian |=, the source must be a literal BIT(n) macro whose n fits target width or a proven host scalar, without a matching conversion. For __aligned_le64 array writes, target declaration must be resolved from the bounded input and a host u64 or readq_relaxed() source plus later object-passing call must be visible. Neither proves device reachability or a defect.

normal applies only to an analyzed site with correct conversion, same representation, or explicit zero enum/define. Zero-valued endian mismatches can be type issues with no byte-level runtime change; normal never clears a whole commit.

insufficient includes unknown macro/expression source, ambiguous or unavailable declaration, absent boundary evidence, and unsupported syntax. Zero recognized sites is checker out of scope, not a clean commit. Runner failures are separate.
Count causal chains by source-reviewed commit after raw runs, never by site count. Purposeful title-selected entries cannot give population accuracy, precision, recall, or speed estimates.
